description: Auditable reasoning architecture that helps third-party risk analysts decide whether to approve, query, escalate or decline a new SaaS vendor, producing a replayable, cited decision with the next action under a signed contract.

agents.name: PlannerAgent
agents.role: Plans registry queries; revises on Evaluator/Challenger feedback

agents.name: EvidenceAgent
agents.role: Runs registry queries; guards and extracts quoted vendor claims

agents.name: EvaluatorAgent
agents.role: Grounds quotes, cross-checks claims against systems of record, sends work back

agents.name: ChallengerAgent
agents.role: Attacks the candidate decision; can force re-plan or escalation only

agents.name: ReporterAgent
agents.role: Writes the cited dossier and drafts actions

agents.name: MemoryKeeper
agents.role: Meterless H-MEM precedents and trust ledger

agents.name: ActionExecutor
agents.role: Meterless Scout execution contracts; approval-gated actions

zetaris.role: Single SQL access point federating five enterprise systems and CISA KEV

engines: Scout Intent (guard and execution contracts subset)

nvidia.access: Via Meterless Nightshift lanes (primary) or build.nvidia.com (fallback)

sample_mode: SAMPLE_MODE=true runs the full agent loop on a DuckDB mirror of the Zetaris model. LLM_PROVIDER=offline, or an unreachable provider under auto, uses the deterministic fallback and labels traces provider offline.
pre_existing_components: See README section Pre-existing components and docs/PRIOR_WORK.md
